title: Workflows: React to Registrations, Sign-Ins and Role Changes | Orchard Core
description:
Registrations, role changes and sign-ins are moments a site often has to react to: greeting an account, telling an editor, or keeping a record of what happened.

The Users module provides events for Workflows, so a workflow can start whenever an account is created, updated or signed in. Build the workflows in the admin designer with an event and a Notify Task, publish them, and follow each run in the workflow instances.

In this video:
• The user events and the user tasks, and what starts each event
• Respond to a created account with User Created Event and a Notify Task
• Create a user and see the notification from the workflow
• Respond to a role change with User Updated Event
• Respond to a sign-in with User Loggedin Event
• Follow the runs in the workflow instances, and read the Correlation ID
